You are given an InflowWind template `/home/user/Desktop/eog_inflow_base.dat`.

1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/eog_inflow.dat`:
- Set IEC standard `1-ED3`, class `A`, and EOG wind type
- Set reference wind speed to 11.4 m/s (rated wind speed)
- Run OpenFAST for 120 s (the gust usually occurs within 0-30 s)

2. Write a post-processing script to parse `.out`:
- Extract the `RootMyb1` (blade-1 out-of-plane root bending moment) time series
- Extract `YawBrTAxp` (tower-top fore-aft displacement)
- Compute peak values for both during the gust period

3. Save to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format:
`rootmyb1_peak_knm, yawbrtaxp_peak_m`

4. Do not use GUI tools.
